items.q: What mindset should you bring into a networking room?
items.a: Enter with **curiosity**, not **client-hunting desperation**. Rooms full of sellers feel slimy; curiosity removes the desperation smell and makes you attractive.

items.q: How do you join a group without freezing?
items.a: Memorize **2–3 conversation starters** — e.g. *"Can I join your conversation? I'm here alone"* or *"What brings you all here?"* Prepared openers unlock courage better than standing with a drink.

items.q: What's the interest ratio that builds friends fast?
items.a: Dale Carnegie: make more friends in **2 months by being interested** than in **2 years trying to be interesting**. When stuck, use **FORD** — Family, Occupation, Recreation, Dreams.

items.q: Should you attend events with no attendee targets?
items.a: No. If there's **no attendee list and no targets**, skip it — a **time-poor filter**, not snobbery. Connect on **LinkedIn ~2 weeks ahead** and read posts/work history so talk goes deep, not weather small talk.

items.q: How do you reference research without sounding creepy?
items.a: Drop **one natural detail** — *"I saw on LinkedIn you worked at Adobe…"* — not a credential dump. Depth comes from homework, not interrogation.

sections.title: At the event: connect then give

items.q: What should be your primary goal in the room?
items.a: **Connection-first**, not "get them to help me." Active listening finds common ground (even a random **Scrubs** moment). An Adobe HR intro is a **bonus**, not the ask.

items.q: What does "give first, ask later" look like in practice?
items.a: Secondary goal: help **their current chapter**. Ali researched Vinh's keynote dream, lined up the **first US keynote in Austin** with no ask — **reciprocity** and lifelong friendship followed organically.

items.q: Why shouldn't a private rejection stop you from trying again?
items.a: The **spotlight effect** plus Mark Twain: others **seldom think of you**. Private rebuffs aren't remembered — you're freer to try again. Intentional networking can put you **one event away from a best friend**.
